subject: Ownership and permitted execution models
minimal_request: Identify authoritative owner/delegation and existing supported workflow/native runtime models, tenancy, namespace and management/stop limits
acceptable_evidence: Signed existing non-secret policy/export; distinguish template/deployment; no provisioning
decision_impact: Without this no candidate compatibility or owner authority can be established

subject: Device/privilege/GPU and physical exclusion
minimal_request: Does approved Isaac/GPU run with GPU-only grant and no privileged/DinD/serial/USB/CAN/admin mounts? Supply physical custody/device/hotplug/runtime policy and explicit unsupported cases
acceptable_evidence: Existing compatibility/policy evidence plus signed inventory; no device probe
decision_impact: If unsupported all three need redesign; diagnostic monitoring cannot compensate

subject: MAVLink/DDS/network enforcement
minimal_request: Supply existing namespace/route/default-deny capability, generated DDS discovery/identity permissions, exact MAVLink peer/API/plugin constraints and management separation
acceptable_evidence: Target-bound effective exports if one exists; otherwise capability-only marked proposed; no operational probe
decision_impact: Required to exclude command bridges/physical routes; domain alone insufficient

subject: Guard context and minimal instrumentation options
minimal_request: Supply existing native hook/event/clock availability and minimal host/executor/plugin support; which internal guard events can passive B actually observe?
acceptable_evidence: Versioned source/build/executor/event manifest; explicitly list absent hooks; no construction
decision_impact: Determines B coverage gap versus A/C observer effects and feasibility

subject: Resource and independent evidence capability
minimal_request: Supply allocation/tenancy, supported independent supervisor/storage/RO collector path and available clock/drop/overhead limits/stop ownership
acceptable_evidence: Existing resource/failure-domain/retention records; proposed numeric limits clearly unapproved; no fault test
decision_impact: Needed for measurement and stop/evidence independence; shared host is not independent failure proof

subject: Immutable configuration and diagnostic claim authority
minimal_request: Identify image/build/source/scene/cache provenance and authoritative F00 startup allocation/originals; identify release rights and diagnostic deviation authority
acceptable_evidence: Authenticated full manifests/hashes/approval chain; missing robot distribution digest remains unknown
decision_impact: Required for exact next offline design; originals/equivalence/qualification remain separate blockers
